import fetcher
import requests_mock
from unittest.mock import MagicMock
import pytest

# Mock client to test fetch behavior
def test_fetch_with_timeout():
    # Mock client to raise Timeout exception
    mock_client = MagicMock()
    mock_client.get.side_effect = requests.exceptions.Timeout("Request timed out")
    
    # Test exception propagation
    with pytest.raises(requests.exceptions.Timeout):
        fetcher.fetch(mock_client, "https://example.com")

# Test successful fetch with timeout
@requests_mock.Mocker()
def test_fetch_success_with_timeout(mock):
    mock.get("https://example.com", text="Success")
    
    # Mock client that uses requests.Session
    mock_client = requests.Session()
    
    # Ensure timeout=30 is passed
    with mock as m:
        m.get("https://example.com")
        fetcher.fetch(mock_client, "https://example.com")
    
    assert m.last_request.method == "GET"
    assert m.last_request.url == "https://example.com"
    assert m.last_request.headers.get("Connection") == "close"  # Timeout implies connection closure
